description: This file contains implementations and fake implementations of ONNX operators as native Torch operations, including functions for Rotary Embedding, Attention, and related utilities, with decorators registering custom ONNX operators.

methods.name: _onnx_op
methods.description: Decorator to register an ONNX operator with a custom implementation.

methods.name: _rotary_embedding_23_fake_impl
methods.description: Fake implementation for RotaryEmbedding-23 for torch.compile purposes.

methods.name: rotary_embedding_23
methods.description: Implementation of the RotaryEmbedding-23 operator, with validation and rotation logic.

methods.name: _get_scale_factor
methods.description: Calculates scale factor for attention based on scale and head size.

methods.name: _reshape_3d_to_4d
methods.description: Reshapes 3D tensor to 4D for multi-head attention.

methods.name: _get_qk_output_for_aten_spda
methods.description: Generates QK output tensor based on mode, with fallback to zeros.

methods.name: _compute_qk_output_for_mode_0
methods.description: Computes QK output for mode 0, handling head dimension adjustments.

methods.name: _attention_23_fake_impl
methods.description: Fake implementation for Attention-23 for torch.compile purposes, generating tensors with correct shapes.

methods.name: attention_23
methods.description: Implementation of the Attention-23 operator, with support for 3D/4D inputs, caching, masking, and softmax modes.
